title: Callsun Homepage
metaDescription: Callsun supplies solar modules and system solutions for global B2B partners — 55,000 m² manufacturing base, 180–720W standard and custom modules, off-grid & hybrid system packages, verified quality, worldwide supply.

hero.title: Photovoltaic Module Brand & Manufacturer
hero.description: Callsun focuses on standard PV modules, custom PV modules, and application-specific solar products, supporting global partners from product selection and engineering development to sample validation and volume delivery.
hero.imageAlt: Callsun solar module manufacturing base with adjacent solar farm and city skyline

productsSection.title: Standard Modules at Scale. Custom Modules Engineered to Fit.
productsSection.description: From high-power standard modules to application-specific formats, Callsun supports product selection, sample validation and reliable volume supply.

solutionsSection.title: Configured for Real-World Energy Requirements
solutionsSection.description: Reference configurations matching PV modules, battery storage, hybrid inverters, cables and protection devices for residential and off-grid applications.

certificationsSection.title: Quality You Can Verify
certificationsSection.description: Callsun maintains quality control across incoming materials, cell inspection, lamination, EL testing, and final module validation. Product performance, safety, and reliability are backed by IEC 61215, IEC 61730, CE, TÜV, ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and other industry-recognized standards, with complete documentation available on request for compliance and channel partners.
certificationsSection.imageAlt: Callsun certifications wall including IEC 61215, IEC 61730, CE, TÜV, ISO 9001 and other quality standards

globalSection.title: Global Supply for Long-Term Channel Partnerships
globalSection.description: Manufacturing and supply resources across multiple regions, supported by warehousing and logistics resources in key international markets — designed for stable delivery and long-term channel partnerships.
globalSection.imageAlt: Callsun global manufacturing and logistics network map — green highlighted markets across North America, South America, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia and Oceania
